scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @daban/desktop && npm run build --workspace @daban/agent && npm run build --workspace @daban/runtime && npm run build --workspace @daban/connect
scripts.typecheck: npm run lint && npm run build:protocol && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev --workspace @daban/desktop
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @daban/runtime && node --experimental-strip-types tools/runtime.ts
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build:runtime && node --experimental-strip-types tools/tests.ts runtime
scripts.lint: biome check . && npm run check:source && npm run db:check
scripts.build:engine: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspace @daban/engine
scripts.build:agent: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @daban/agent
scripts.test:agent: npm run build:agent && vitest run --project node dist-agent
scripts.test:remote: npm run build:engine && npm run build --workspace @daban/desktop && npm run build --workspace @daban/connect && node --experimental-strip-types tools/remote.acceptance.ts
